name: How do I choose the right vanity size for a primary bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right vanity size for a primary bathroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: The vanity should be sized around circulation, storage, plumbing, and the users’ routines rather than maximum width alone. Two sinks may help a busy household, but one larger basin with drawers can provide better usable storage in a tighter room. Context: vanity placement also affects lighting, mirror width, door clearance, and the location of outlets. Key factors: wall length, drawer access, knee clearance, sink count, countertop depth, linen storage, and plumbing position. Practical guidance: inventory what must live in the vanity, measure your current storage, and identify appliances that need outlets. Confirm drawer openings will not collide with doors or toilet clearances. Elite Remodeling & Design can coordinate cabinetry, countertops, lighting, and plumbing in the layout stage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Start with storage and clearance, then decide whether two sinks genuinely improve the routine. Measure wall length, door and drawer swings, countertop depth, outlets, and plumbing locations. A single sink with wider drawers may outperform a cramped double vanity in a smaller room.
